articles.title: Verstappen and Lawson given grid penalties for Mexico practice collision
articles.description: Max Verstappen accuses Liam Lawson of "not very smart behaviour" after the two collided in Friday practice at the Mexico City Grand Prix.

articles.title: F1 has never had anyone like me - Hamilton
articles.description: Lewis Hamilton says he is unlike any driver Formula 1 has seen before and reaffirms a determination to keep racing into his mid-forties.

articles.title: Antonelli to miss Mexico media day with illness
articles.description: Kimi Antonelli is to miss Thursday's Mexico City Grand Prix media day with an illness as he stands on the brink of clinching his first world title.

articles.title: How to follow Mexico City Grand Prix on the BBC
articles.description: All the key BBC coverage details for the Mexico City Grand Prix, which takes place from 30 October to 1 November.

articles.title: Perez signs multi-year extension with Cadillac
